04 / LOOK OUT FOR YOURSELF

Street smart. Student ready.

A few small habits for a better day out.

YOU FIRST, ALWAYS
01

Travel together, travel aware.

Use well-lit, busy stops. Keep your phone and bag close, and share your meeting point with a friend. At Garidi and other meeting points, stand clear of traffic and confirm the safe side of the road.

02

A little outdoor protection.

Cover up outdoors, use insect repellent as directed, and pack water. Shade and sunscreen make those walks between stops much more comfortable.

03

Keep your health in check.

Review your MMR (measles) and polio vaccines with a clinician. CDC’s Algeria page lists global measles and polio notices; check for updates before travel.

Read current CDC guidance Guidance checked 14 Oct 2026 · not medical advice

A NOTE ON THIS GUIDE

Local context. Honest details.

All six pins are decoded from the short plus codes you supplied, resolved near Kouba (36.726, 3.083). Each marker is at the centre of its code cell. The codes locate a shared point; place names, campus entrances and boarding positions have not been independently surveyed.

We read each code followed by its place label, in your message order. “Pante Garidi” and “ENS cous” retain your supplied labels. Arrêt Aïn Naadja is the supplied boarding reference in Kouba, not the hospital or the Aïn Naadja destination neighbourhood. Arrêt de bus vers Ben Omar is likewise a departure point, not a pin in Ben Omar.

Dashed orange lines are illustrative links from ENSTP, not road-following directions or official ETUSA routes. Walking and onward-journey links open Google Maps; route and public-transport coverage depend on that external service. This site has no live bus arrivals or verified fares.

Your destination is not stored by this site. It is sent to Google Maps only when you open the generated directions link. Plus codes are location codes, not postal codes. ENSTP 16006 and ENS 16308 are school mailing addresses, not verified postcodes for nearby stops.

Health & weather

CDC Algeria traveler guidance, checked 14 October 2026. Consult a clinician for personal vaccination advice. Live weather comes from Open-Meteo; unavailable readings are never replaced with made-up weather.

Photography

Photos identify a campus, landmark or nearby area as stated in each caption; they do not verify the precise stop. Photo sources are linked in each gallery preview. The Algiers hero photo is from Rich Edwards Imagery. Verify image reuse permissions before public commercial deployment.
